name: template-creation
description: Skill for creating new code templates (Cookiecutter, Copier, Maven)

steps.details: Determine if the template should be Cookiecutter (Python projects), Copier (modern projects with updates), or Maven (Java/JVM projects)
Create appropriate directory in templates/cookiecutter/, templates/copier/, or templates/maven/
Create cookiecutter.json, copier.yml, or archetype-metadata.xml with required properties
Add template files with placeholders using Jinja2 syntax ({{ variable }}) or Maven placeholders (${variable})
Create README template explaining the generated project structure and usage
Use the MCP server or command-line tools to test template generation
